title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP TS-464 Netmgr Endpoint Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-464 NAS devices. An attacker must first obtain the ability to make modifications to device configuration in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the legacy_api endpoints. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of admin.
